caveats: Talents are a real player's: this exact build was logged on 3 ranked Mythic kill(s) of Nek'zali, the Soulcoiler in Warcraft Logs, latest read 2026-07-16 (a pre-release raid-test window; the season's live raid had no ranked kills when this was harvested).
